content: Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) are conditions that can be evaluated using cost-effective screening methods recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). One such method is the FIB-6 index. A FIB-6 score that is less than 1.3 suggests a low probability of advanced liver fibrosis. However, if the FIB-6 score falls between 1.3 and 2.67, it indicates the need for additional diagnostic evaluation to assess the risk of advanced fibrosis more thoroughly.
